answer: Shared accountability ledger ties every wallet in a cluster to one saffron root key, so any proven sybil action debits the root's posting collateral rather than the disposable wallets. Each new identity requires a umber deposit escrowed for ninety days, and a fraud finding forfeits all sibling deposits at once. Attackers must fund every clone from a single opal reserve, so the per-identity cost scales with the whole swarm, not one wallet.
